tara: quick Q — where's the best place to pull p50/p95/p99 for TTFT and tokens/sec for /v1/generate (hosted prod)? planning an alert tweak, want to avoid noise. anyone with pointers?

sam: use the Grafana "Latency & Token Rates" board (Latency + Token panels). quick link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/latency_tokenboard — set the route var to /v1/generate.

maria: metric names we normally use: 
- TTFT histogram: service_inference_ttft_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}
- token counter: model_tokens_emitted_total{route="/v1/generate"}

promql examples (paste into Explore panel):
```
# p95 TTFT (5m window)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(service_inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route))
# tokens/sec for route
sum(rate(model_tokens_emitted_total{route="/v1/generate"}[1m]))
```

sam: also check the "Request breakdown" panel (cold vs warm) + the model_variant filter. cold starts show up as a fat tail on the histogram.

josh: fyi obs-bot fired earlier today: `ALERT ttft_p95_high /v1/generate` — trace id in logs: req=7a3f. jaeger link: https://jaeger.redwood.ai/trace/7a3f

tara: thanks. current alert rule is ttft_p95 > 1.2s for 10m and it's noisy during deploys. any recommendations for tuning?

maria: my suggestions: split thresholds by model_variant & region (different SLAs), and add a token-rate guard so we don't alert when token emission is spiking. e.g.:
```
# pseudo-expr: only alert when p95 high AND tokens/sec is below a burst guard
(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(service_inference_ttft_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route)) > THRESHOLD)
  and
(sum(rate(model_tokens_emitted_total{route="/v1/generate"}[1m])) < TOKEN_RATE_LIMIT)
```
Also consider lowering evaluation window to 5m for noisy routes, and use per-variant thresholds (small models ~0.25s, medium ~0.5s, large ~0.9s).

josh: add a suppression during deploys (deploy-bot tag) and float alerts to severity=info for short spikes. put notes in the alert doc so oncall knows to check trace+tokens before paging.

sam: quick way to find the request_id in logs: Kibana query `json.request_id: '7a3f'` or search for header `x-request-id:7a3f` in the access logs. span tags in Jaeger also have request_id.

tara: perfect — i'll draft a PR with the updated alert rule (split by variant + token guard) and assign @maria for review. will also add a link to the Grafana panels and the runbook. :thumbsup:

obs-bot: PR created: #842 — "alert/ttft-per-variant-and-token-guard" by tara. CI checks passed.

sam: thanks — ping here when it's merged so we can schedule a short burn-in window after deploy.
